subject: Death Mountain Trail
text: A Piece of Heart can be reached above Dodongo's Cavern by backflipping over the shortened fence from the Bomb Flower alcove as Young Link, or by riding the Magic Leaf as Adult Link after planting Magic Beans near the cavern entrance.

evidence.quote: Stand in the small alcove with the Bomb Flower, and do a backflip over the shortened bit of fence.  You'll land on the cliff below.  Alternatively, you can plant the Magic Beans near the entrance to Dodongo's Cavern as Young Link, then return as Adult Link and ride the Magic Leaf up to the Heart Piece.

subject: Death Mountain Crater
text: A Piece of Heart is located in an alcove halfway down the cliff on the north side of Death Mountain Crater, accessible by climbing down the cliff and approaching from below.

evidence.quote: The Heart Piece can be found in an alcove halfway down the cliff on the north side of Death Mountain Crater.  Climb down the cliff and approach the alcove from below to get the Piece of Heart.

subject: Death Mountain Crater
text: Without the Goron Tunic, Young Link will die if time runs out in the extreme heat of Death Mountain Crater, and fairies will not help.

evidence.quote: Without the aid of the Goron Tunic, Young Link is susceptible to the extreme heat of Death Mountain Crater.  If you fail to reach the Piece of Heart before time runs out, then you will DIE.  Fairies don't help you.

subject: Death Mountain Crater
text: A Piece of Heart sits on top of a massive rock near the warp-in point in Death Mountain Crater, reached by riding the Magic Leaf grown from planting Magic Beans in the soft earth patch to the left of the warp.

evidence.quote: There is a patch of soft earth just to your left as you warp in.  Plant the Magic Beans, then either save and quit out or use the Prelude of Light to return to the Temple of Time.  Go forward in time to Adult Link, and return to Death Mountain Crater.  Use the Magic Leaf to ride around to the Piece of Heart, which is on top of one of the massive rocks near the warp-in point.

subject: Goron City
text: Lighting all torches on the bottom floor of Goron City causes the large pot to spin, and stopping it with an explosive bomb so that the happy face points forward reveals a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote: Use a Deku Stick to transfer the flame from Darunia's Room to the torches around the bottom floor of Goron City.  Once all of the torches are lit, then the large pot will begin to spin.  Run up to the next level of Goron City so that you are level with the top of the pot.  Throw a bomb into the pot, and when it explodes the pot will stop spinning.  If the pot stops with the happy face pointing forward, then a Piece of Heart will appear.

subject: Zora's River
text: A Piece of Heart rests on top of a high pillar halfway up Zora's River, accessible with a Cucco, the Boomerang, or the Hover Boots.

evidence.quote: At the top of the ladder, grab another Cucco and use it to hover over to the top of the pillar, which holds a Heart Piece.  Alternatively, you can also use the Boomerang with Young Link or the Hover Boots with Adult Link.

subject: Musical Frogs
text: Playing the Song of Storms for the Musical Frogs in Zora's River rewards Link with a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote: Go to the Musical Frogs, and play them the Song of Storms.  They will reward you with  a Piece of Heart.

subject: Musical Frogs
text: Playing the basic songs initiates a minigame where eating the flies in sequence earns a Piece of Heart: A Button, C-Left, C-Right, C-Down, C-Left, C-Right, C-Down, A Button, C-Down, A Button, C-Down, C-Right, C-Left, A Button.

evidence.quote: Play all of the basic songs (Zelda's Lullaby, Epona's Song, Sun's Song, Saria's Song, Song of Storms and Song of Time), and the Musical Frogs will play a Musical Game with you.  Flies will appear above the Frog's heads, and you must press the button associated with that frog to make him eat it....The order is as follows: A Button, C-Left, C-Right, C-Down, C-Left, C-Right, C-Down, A Button, C-Down, A Button, C-Down, C-Right, C-Left, A Button

subject: Zora's River
text: Near the entrance to Zora's Domain, a platform back downstream holds a Piece of Heart that can be reached using a Cucco, the Boomerang, or the Hover Boots.

evidence.quote: From the high ledge near the entrance to Zora's Domain, turn around and look back downstream.  You'll see a platform with a Piece of Heart on it.  Use the Cucco to glide out to it.  Alternatively, you can also use the Boomerang or the Hover Boots.

subject: Zora's Domain
text: Lighting all braziers across Zora's Domain before any burn out reveals a chest behind the waterfall containing a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote: If you did it fast enough so that you lit all the braziers without any of them burning out, then a chest will appear behind the Waterfall which contains a Piece of Heart.
